# catl version

Print catl version and build information

**Category:** Catalog

## Usage

```bash
catl version [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag            | Description                                  |
| :-------------- | :------------------------------------------- |
| `-v, --verbose` | Print extended build and runtime diagnostics |
